title: Buckeyes & Keystone
tagline: Ohio State football, Pennsylvania, Pittsburgh and Johnstown.

questions.question: What is Ohio Stadium's famous nickname?
questions.fact: Ohio Stadium opened in 1922. Fans just call it The Shoe.

questions.question: What does the Ohio State marching band famously spell out on the field?
questions.fact: A sousaphone player gets the honor of dotting the i.

questions.question: Which instrument does the band member who dots the i in Script Ohio play?
Which coach led Ohio State football from 1951 to 1978?
Which Buckeye is the only player ever to win the Heisman Trophy twice?
questions.fact: Griffin won it back to back, in 1974 and 1975.

questions.question: What do Ohio State players earn as helmet stickers for big plays?
What is a buckeye, exactly?
questions.fact: The buckeye is Ohio's state tree. The nut is said to look like a deer's eye.

questions.question: Which song, a favorite of the Ohio State band, is also Ohio's official rock song?
What is the name of Ohio State's alma mater song?

The 1889 Johnstown Flood began when which dam failed?
questions.fact: The dam held a private lake for a club whose members included Andrew Carnegie and Henry Clay Frick.

questions.question: Who led the American Red Cross relief effort in Johnstown after the 1889 flood?
questions.fact: It was one of the Red Cross's first major disaster relief efforts.

questions.question: The Johnstown Inclined Plane is billed as the world's steepest what?
questions.fact: It opened in 1891, two years after the flood, and can carry cars as well as people.

questions.question: Which two rivers meet in Johnstown to form the Conemaugh River?
questions.answer: The Little Conemaugh and the Stonycreek

questions.question: Johnstown has had three great floods: 1889, 1936 and which other year?
Which 1977 Paul Newman hockey comedy was filmed largely in Johnstown?
questions.fact: The Charlestown Chiefs were based on the real Johnstown Jets.
